entries.name: Night Grain
entries.blurb: Charcoal grain and cream type on near-black — a moody studio dark warmed by paper highlights and one signal red.

display.note: Khteka is a licensed grotesque — Instrument Sans carries the same cut, characterful terminals.

body.note: The site runs one face throughout; Instrument Sans covers both roles.

mono.note: Suisse Intl Mono is premium — Geist Mono is the closest neutral grotesque mono.

entries.name: Chalkline
entries.blurb: Gallery white, gallery black, one deep cobalt jolt — monolithic display type over microscopic mono details.

display.note: PP Neue Montreal is premium — Inter matches its neutral neo-grotesque voice and full weight range.

body.note: Same substitution as display — the site uses one family everywhere.

mono.note: Already free — the source site ships IBM Plex Mono as-is.

entries.name: Acid Bloom
entries.blurb: Ink-dark canvas, warm cream copy and acid-lime shouts — organic texture with pop-art red.

display.note: Suisse BP Int'l is a licensed Swiss grotesque — Archivo matches its wide, confident capitals.

body.note: Suisse Int'l is premium — Inter is the standard free stand-in for its neutral text colour.

mono.note: The site's Sometype pairing maps to Sometype Mono on Google Fonts — free as-is.

entries.name: Rose Static
entries.blurb: Warm-white paper, condensed gothic black and lip-red — glam grunge with torn-collage energy.

display.note: Thunder is a licensed condensed display face — Oswald is the closest free condensed with the same weight ladder.

body.note: Already free — the source site ships Inter as-is.

mono.note: PP Fraktion Mono is premium — Fragment Mono carries the same squared technical mono tone.

entries.name: Paper Grid
entries.blurb: Cream graph paper, cornflower ink and hand-written notes — a working sketchbook, published.

display.note: F37 Analog is a licensed retro-technical face — Space Grotesk shares its quirks and geometric skeleton.

body.note: Graphik is premium — DM Sans matches its friendly, workmanlike text colour (and ships on the site too).

mono.note: Already free — the source site ships Geist Mono as-is.

entries.name: Thermal Print
entries.blurb: Report-clean white and editorial black — thermal-gradient art, signal orange and pastel lilac.

display.note: Beausite Classic is a licensed neo-grotesque — Inter Tight keeps its tight editorial setting.

body.note: Already free — the source site ships Inter as-is.

entries.name: Volt Chrome
entries.blurb: Electric ultramarine with chrome objects and white type — a portfolio floating in blue space.

display.note: The site's custom variable grotesque spans 100–900 — Archivo covers the same range with a similar squared-neutral cut.

body.note: One custom family drives the whole site — Archivo stands in for both roles.
